offers.rq: The Foundation: You hold a degree in Software Engineering, Computer Science, or have a similar technical background. Language Agnostic: While we primarily use.NET/C# (and knowing it well is a major plus!), we value core engineering principles above all. If you are proficient in another language (like Java, Python, or C++) and are eager to learn our stack, we want to hear from you.
